listing.name: Burnout Revenge (Xbox 360) — burnout-revenge (secretpray)
listing.summary: Upstream describes racing/Crash features on Apple Silicon. README announces v0.1.25 controller-slot recovery, Xbox USB vibration notice, bounded background My Music indexing and soundtrack recovery; this audit does not select or qualify a new release asset. Two physical local controllers and multiplayer between two Macs remain untested; no Portcove gameplay or completion verification. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Burnout Revenge (Xbox 360) Xbox 360 disc ISO. USA disc; European language import/add-ons optional.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Install macOS DMG and select own USA ISO for first-run import; European language/add-on imports are optional.
